samples.xml_description:
<module id="radix2_div">
    <description>A simplified radix-2 divider for 8-bit signed or unsigned integers.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">The clock signal used for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="rst">The reset signal to initialize or reset the module.</input>
        <input id="sign">Indicates if the operation is signed (1) or unsigned (0).</input>
        <input id="dividend" width_description="[7:0]">The dividend for division.</input>
        <input id="divisor" width_description="[7:0]">The divisor for division.</input>
        <input id="opn_valid">A valid operation request is present.</input>
        <output id="res_valid">The result is valid and ready.</output>
        <output id="result" width_description="[15:0]">The output containing the remainder in the upper 8 bits and the quotient in the lower 8 bits.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="IDLE">0</parameter>
        <parameter id="DIVIDE">1</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="state" width_description="1">The current state of the divider.</reg>
        <reg id="next_state" width_description="1">The next state of the divider.</reg>
        <reg id="res_valid_reg" width_description="1">Register to hold the result validity flag.</reg>
        <reg id="start_cnt" width_description="1">Flag to indicate the start of the division process.</reg>
        <reg id="cnt" width_description="4">Counter to keep track of the number of iterations.</reg>
        <reg id="neg_divisor" width_description="[8:0]">Negative divisor for subtraction.</reg>
        <reg id="remainder" width_description="[8:0]">Remainder during division.</reg>
        <reg id="quotient" width_description="[8:0]">Quotient during division.</reg>
        <reg id="SR" width_description="[9:0]">Shift register for storing the dividend.</reg>
        <wire id="sub_result" width_description="[9:0]">Result of subtraction between SR and NEG_DIVISOR.</wire>
        <wire id="carry_out">Carry-out from the subtraction operation.</wire>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // State machine for controlling the division process
        always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
            if (rst) begin
                state <= IDLE;
            end else begin
                state <= next_state;
            end
        end
        
        // Next state logic
        always @(*) begin
            case(state)
                IDLE: begin
                    if (opn_valid && !res_valid_reg) begin
                        next_state = DIVIDE;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = IDLE;
                    end
                end
                DIVIDE: begin
                    if (!start_cnt || cnt == 8) begin
                        next_state = IDLE;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = DIVIDE;
                    end
                end
                default: next_state = IDLE;
            endcase
        end
        
        // Output logic
        always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
            if (rst) begin
                res_valid_reg <= 0;
                start_cnt <= 0;
                cnt <= 0;
                neg_divisor <= 0;
                remainder <= 0;
                quotient <= 0;
                SR <= 0;
            end else begin
                case(state)
                    IDLE: begin
                        if (opn_valid && !res_valid_reg) begin
                            start_cnt <= 1;
                            cnt <= 1;
                            neg_divisor <= {~(|divisor[7:0]), divisor};
                            remainder <= 0;
                            quotient <= 0;
                            SR <= {1'b0, dividend} << 1;
                        end
                    end
                    DIVIDE: begin
                        if (start_cnt) begin
                            if (&cnt) begin
                                start_cnt <= 0;
                                cnt <= 0;
                                SR <= {sub_result[8], sub_result[8:0]};
                                res_valid_reg <= 1;
                            end else begin
                                cnt <= cnt + 1;
                                SR <= {carry_out, SR[8:1]};
                            end
                        end
                    end
                endcase
            end
        end
        
        // Subtraction logic
        assign sub_result = SR - neg_divisor;
        
        // Carry-out logic
        assign carry_out = ~sub_result[9];
        
        // Result assignment
        assign result = {remainder[8:0], quotient[8:0]};
        assign res_valid = res_valid_reg;
    </implementation>
</module>
